packageRules.description: grunt-eslint 25+ bundles eslint 9+, but eslint-config-wikimedia 0.32.x requires eslint ^8.57 and .eslintrc.json is the legacy format. Remove this ceiling once eslint-config-wikimedia and the ESLint configuration are moved to eslint 9 and the flat config format, and upgrade them together in the same PR (checked 2026-11-28).
